slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective function. It only asked about distance, then silently assumed the objective was to minimize total rental cost in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total rental cost (proportional to distance).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked what should be minimized or confirmed the objective; it assumed cost minimization without user confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot remained unresolved, having never asked about the optimization goal.

summary: The agent asked only about trip distance and then stopped, silently assuming the objective was to minimize total rental cost. It failed to clarify the P0 objective slot, making the model's goal unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
